subject: Temporary quota uplift request — 48h concurrency soak for MoleculeAI POC
messages:
From: Sarah Park <sarah@molecule.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.inference>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary quota uplift for 48h concurrency soak

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo today — the team and I are excited about Redwood. As discussed, we want to run a focused concurrency soak to validate latency P95/P99 behavior under steady-state traffic before we sign the contract.

Ask: can Redwood provision a temporary quota uplift (trial credits or promo top-up) for 48 hours next week? Target window: Tue 2027-05-04 09:00 PDT -> Wed 2027-05-05 09:00 PDT. Expected load profile: 800 concurrent sessions, avg prompt length ~200 tokens, background KV cache enabled. We attached a short soak plan and a small sample of expected runtime metrics.

Acceptance criteria for MoleculeAI:
- P95 generation latency <= 280ms
- No more than 1% request errors
- Aggregated token cost estimate for the window

Let us know what info you need from your end to make this happen and whether a promo/top-up or temp quota is cleaner for Redwood billing.

Appreciate it — Sarah

--
Sarah Park
Head of ML Ops, MoleculeAI
[sarah@molecule.ai]

Attachments: moleculeai_soak-plan.md (text/markdown), runtime-metrics-sample.csv (text/csv)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.inference>
To: Sarah Park <sarah@molecule.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary quota uplift for 48h concurrency soak

Sarah — thanks for the clear plan and times. We can absolutely support a 48-hour concurrency soak.

Quick notes / internal asks:
- I need confirmation from finance/billing on whether to apply a temporary promo credit vs explicit quota uplift tied to the trial account.
- Rishi, can you estimate the token burn and confirm we have dedicated pool capacity for that window? Lauren, can you approve a one-off promo if necessary?

I'll loop in Billing if we need a promo flow. If you can confirm the exact start/end timestamp in UTC and share any IP allowlists, we'll lock the window.

Jonas
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.inference

Looping in numbers so we can act fast. Based on Sarah's sample and our model:
- Estimated total tokens: ~48M tokens across 48 hours (right tail traffic baked in)
- Recommended approach: grant a timeboxed promo credit equal to the estimated token cost (safer for trial accounts) and set a hard-cap to prevent overspend.
- We have spare capacity in the us-west pool; no infra changes needed, just allocate from burst reserve.

I can put the promo through once Lauren signs off. If we do a quota uplift instead, we need Billing to create a temporary quota bucket and manual cap.

Rishi
Sr. Customer Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
